assumption_inventory.statement: For a compact complex manifold X and holomorphic vector bundle V, Serre duality pairs H^q(X,Omega^p(V)) perfectly with H^(n-q)(X,Omega^(n-p)(V*)). For a smooth compact curve this gives H1(C,B)=H0(C,K_C tensor B^-1)^*.
assumption_inventory.source: J.-P. Serre, Un theoreme de dualite, Comment. Math. Helv. 29 (1955), 9-26; primary PDF obtained and section 3 Theorem 4 and section 4 Theorem 5 read. The contour normalization is derived separately in the jet report.
assumption_inventory.locator: section 3, no.13, Theorem 4 (p.22); section 4, no.16, Theorem 5 and corollary (p.24)

assumption_inventory.statement: If X is a Stein manifold and F a coherent analytic sheaf on X, H^q(X,F)=0 for every q>=1.
assumption_inventory.source: H. Cartan, Faisceaux analytiques sur les varietes de Stein, Seminaire Henri Cartan 4 (1951-1952), expose 18; original page 18-7 inspected, including the q>=1 inequality misread by OCR.

assumption_inventory.source: Manuscript 03-trace.tex cites Hartshorne, Residues and Duality, III.6, and Grothendieck1957 section 2 Theorem 2.1 and corollary. These applications remain unexamined upstream dependencies.

assumption_inventory.statement: Normal-surface Hartogs extension applies to extend the frame and coefficients across the contracted point.
assumption_inventory.source: Manuscript 05-analytic.tex, Demailly Chapter II Corollary 7.8. Unverified downstream application.

assumption_inventory.source: Manuscript 06-algebraization.tex: Barajas-Chavez-Martinez-Romano-Velazquez section 1.6 Theorem 1.17; unexamined.

assumption_inventory.source: Serre, Geometrie algebrique et geometrie analytique (1956); primary Numdam PDF and Theorem 1 read, archived in research/literature.

assumption_inventory.statement: A compact nowhere-discrete curve in a smooth complex surface with negative-definite intersection matrix is exceptional: it admits a proper contraction biholomorphic on the complements with descent of holomorphic functions; the holomorphic reduction of a normal source has normal target and connected fibers.
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert, Uber Modifikationen und exzeptionelle analytische Mengen, Math. Ann. 146 (1962), 331-368; original GDZ scan read.
assumption_inventory.locator: Section 4.8(e), pp.366-367; section 2.1, p.337; section 2.4, Definition 3, pp.339-340

assumption_inventory.statement: The nilradical of a complex space has a uniform nilpotence exponent on a relatively compact set. Analytic structure sheaves are coherent, and coherent sheaves are closed under kernels, cokernels, images, tensor products and Hom. In particular these facts apply to the possibly nonreduced subspace (C,O_Y/J).
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert 1960; compact nilpotence and analytic coherence statements read in the original Numdam scan.
assumption_inventory.locator: Section 1.6, Satz 4 and its proof, p.15; section 2.1, Definition 3 and properties (a)-(c), p.16

assumption_inventory.statement: For a proper holomorphic map of complex spaces and a coherent analytic sheaf on the source, every higher direct image is coherent; no flatness hypothesis is imposed.
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert 1960, with the 1963 proof correction; the introduction fixes the source/target printing error in the p.59 formulation.
assumption_inventory.locator: Introduction statement (I), p.7; section 6.5, Hauptsatz I, p.59

assumption_inventory.statement: For a proper holomorphic map pi:Y->X and coherent E, the m_x-adic completion of (R^q pi_*E)_x is the inverse limit of (R^q pi_*(E/(m_x O_Y)^r E))_x. Ordinary ideal powers are used. No flatness or termwise base-change is assumed.
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert 1960, corrected by Berichtigung (1963), DOI 10.1007/BF02684291; both original statements read.
assumption_inventory.locator: Section 6.5, definition of the ideals preceding Hauptsatz II, and Hauptsatz IIa, p.59

assumption_inventory.statement: The 1963 correction repairs the indicated polyradius estimates and induction arguments, and withdraws the claimed closedness of the failure locus in section 7 Satz 2. It does not withdraw section 6 Hauptsatze I and IIa or add flatness to them.
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert, Berichtigung, Publ. Math. IHES 16 (1963),35-36, complete original correction read.

assumption_inventory.statement: For a holomorphically complete complex space, including a singular or nonreduced one, every coherent analytic sheaf has zero cohomology in degrees q>0.
assumption_inventory.source: Grauert 1960, space version of Cartan B, original statement read.

assumption_inventory.statement: For a line bundle B on a smooth compact complex curve C, H1(C,B) is dual to H0(C,K_C tensor B^-1).
assumption_inventory.source: Serre, Un theoreme de dualite (1955); the primary-source reading in the two completed upstream reviews is reused.
assumption_inventory.locator: Section 3 no.13 Theorem 4, p.22, and section 4 no.16 Theorem 5, p.24

assumption_inventory.locator: Section 2.4, Definition 2.18 and following paragraph, p.19

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: Completion at an ideal of a Noetherian ring is exact on finite modules, and completed finite modules equal tensor product with the completed ring.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: A Noetherian local ring is regular if and only if its maximal-ideal completion is regular.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: The completion of a normal Noetherian local ring with normal formal fibres, in particular an excellent normal local ring, is normal.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: Cutkosky, Etoiles and Valuations, version actually read: 2 December 2016; research/literature/algebraization_sources/cutkosky_excellence_excerpt.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: Artin 1969, original Numdam scan; research/literature/algebraization_sources/artin_approximation_excerpt.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: The henselization of a local ring is the filtered colimit of pointed etale algebras with unchanged residue field; finitely many represented equalities hold at a common later pointed stage.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.
assumption_inventory.locator: Lemma 10.155.1 and the explicit filtered-category construction in its proof

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: An etale ring map R->S admits a presentation S=R[z_1,...,z_n]/(h_1,...,h_n) with invertible square Jacobian determinant in S.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: Fields and finite-type algebras over fields are excellent.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: For a finite-type domain S over a field, dim(S)=dim(S_m) for every maximal ideal m.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.

assumption_inventory.statement: For a finite-type scheme over a field, its topological dimension at a point is the maximum dimension of the irreducible components through that point.
assumption_inventory.source: The Stacks Project, primary statement read 2026-11-05; research/literature/algebraization_sources/stacks_inputs.txt.
